end.summary:
- Practised place value and expanding base-10 numbers using powers of 10.
- Discussed bases, including why whole numbers above 1 can be used as bases.
- Began converting numbers between base 10, base 5, and base 2.
- Neel continued to treat zero as removable in 5,030 and 530; this was not corrected by the last seen turn.
- Neel continued to read “10” as ten in every base; this was not corrected by the last seen turn.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place-value expansion, the meaning of a base, and conversions in base 5 and base 2 with Neel. Neel used grouping and place positions to discuss some examples, and the visual approach was requested for unfamiliar base conversions. The mix-ups about zero as a placeholder and the meaning of “10” in different bases remained at the end; at home, use small groups of objects to show that each completed group becomes one unit in the next place.

पाँच पतंगों का एक समूह बना? तो... पाँच में से पाँच गए, कुछ नहीं बचा। शून्य?
Haan, paanch patangon ka ek samooh bana aur ek bhi nahi bachi. Paanch ke aadhaar mein pehle samooh ka ank likhte hain, phir bachi hui patangon ka. Toh 4 ke baad kaunse do ank likhenge?
एक-शून्य बेस पाँच... याने पाँच? पर ये तो दस जैसा दिखता है, कन्फ्यूज़न हो रहा है

Haan, paanch ke aadhaar mein 10 ka matlab paanch hai. Dono ka likhaavat ek jaisa hai, par aadhaar badalne se samooh ka aakaar badalta hai. Ab do ke aadhaar mein 1011 ko das ke aadhaar mein kaise badlenge?
पता नहीं, 1011 का बेस दो... एक-एक-शून्य-एक... एक हज़ार ग्यारह नहीं है? ये सब समझ नहीं आ रहा, गेम खेलें?

Haan, 1011 ko ek hazaar gyaarah padhna aasaan lagta hai, par do ke aadhaar mein jagahon ki keemat alag hoti hai. Abhi game nahi bana sakti; chaliye bolkar chhota khel khelte hain. Jagahon ki keemat: sabse daayein wala 1 kitni ikai dikhata hai?
सबसे दाएँ वाला एक... एक ही है ना? मतलब एक यूनिट।
Haan, sabse daayein wala 1 ek ikai dikhata hai. Do ke aadhaar mein ek jagah baayein jaane par keemat dugni hoti hai. Sabse daayein wale 1 ke baayein jo 1 hai, uski keemat kitni hogi?
दुगनी... माने दो? तो वो दो दिखाएगा?
Haan, us jagah ka 1 do dikhata hai. Har jagah baayein jaane par keemat dugni hoti hai; beech ka 0 us jagah se kuch nahi jodta. 1011 mein sabse baayein wala 1 kitna dikhata hai?
